title: Mimar Sinan Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: The named mosque envelope supplies the building replacement boundary and its courtyard is reconstructed open.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain on the public street approach beyond the northwest courtyard arcade.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap Mimar Sinan Mosque relation, prayer hall and open inner courtyard in Ataşehir.
mapIdentity.scope: The named OpenStreetMap multipolygon includes the roof envelope and the open court. The park and one linked approach corroborate the mosque massing and its position above the south-facing public ground.

note: Hassa Architecture describes the six-pier and six-half-dome composition. The exact public-domain native Qualla photo shows pale stone, grey-blue ribs, dark-and-light arch voussoirs, three balconies per minaret and the lead-toned spires.
